title: Learning something new
intro: Trying something unfamiliar can feel odd and interesting at once. A few open questions, with no right answers.

prompts.text: What is something you are curious to learn at the moment?
prompts.followUp: What is one small step you could take towards it?

prompts.text: Think of a time you got the hang of something that once felt awkward. What helped?
What does it feel like when you meet something unfamiliar?
Who or what has been a good teacher for you, and what made them good?
What is a question you would like to ask, if there were no such thing as a silly question?
What is a small thing you understand now that you did not understand last month?
How do you like to practise something new: little and often, or in one long go?
prompts.followUp: What would make it more enjoyable?

prompts.text: What would you try this week if it did not matter whether you were good at it?
